summary: Backend-only testing of new Telegram integration in Next.js app (/app/next-nova-taxi) on port 3100. Verified POST /api/bookings now invokes Telegram sendMessage (previously missing), tracks result in adminTelegramNotification field, persists it to MongoDB, and that /api/pricing/diag exposes a telegramTest probe. All 8 pytest tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: adminTelegramNotification in response includes chatId only in MongoDB doc but not in response (expected since response is intentionally minimal). OK.
Mongo update after notification uses .catch(() => {}) — silently swallows persistence errors; low-priority robustness note.
sendTelegramMessage uses fetch directly without timeout — a slow Telegram API response could stall booking creation. Consider AbortController with 10s timeout for production hardening.
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID is returned verbatim in both diag env dump and booking Mongo doc; acceptable since diag is admin-auth protected, but note PII/leak surface.
updated_files: /app/next-nova-taxi/.env.local (restored to invalid test creds after tests)
test_credentials: ADMIN_PASSWORD=NovaTaxi2026Admin for /api/pricing/diag (via x-admin-key header). Telegram creds in .env.local: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=invalid_test_token, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=-100000 (intentional invalid for proof-of-invocation).
seed_data_creation: Test bookings prefixed TEST_ are inserted and cleaned up by MongoDB fixture teardown. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js dev server runs on port 3100 via `cd /app/next-nova-taxi && yarn dev -p 3100` (NOT supervisor-managed; separate from CRA frontend on 3000). To change env for tests, rewrite /app/next-nova-taxi/.env.local and restart the yarn/next process (pkill -9 -f 'next dev' then relaunch). Current .env.local is left with invalid Telegram creds so repeated runs produce deterministic 404 'Not Found' error. All 8 tests in test_telegram_bookings.py pass.

verification_evidence.rate_limit: 5 req/min returns 429 for 6th+ request from same IP; rate-limited requests never reach Telegram send code path (short-circuit before body parsing).

tests_mapped_to_assertions.POST /api/bookings with valid Telegram c: NOT tested — no real Telegram token available. Covered indirectly by diag probe code path and the invalid-token test which proves the fetch is invoked.
tests_mapped_to_assertions.POST /api/bookings with INVALID token ->: PASS — error='Not Found', errorCode=404 bubbled from Telegram API
tests_mapped_to_assertions.buildAdminMessage includes shortId/name/: PASS indirectly — doc.confirmToken stored, shortId matches response, confirmToken NOT leaked to public response (SEC-001)
tests_mapped_to_assertions.Rate-limit 429 and no Telegram send on r: PASS (TestRateLimit::test_rate_limit_429) — 429 returned before body parsing so Telegram code unreachable
